input_requirement: System-A must add System-B to their downstream systems and allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow.

ambiguities.fragment: add System-B to their downstream systems
ambiguities.explanation: The pronoun 'their' has two competing antecedents in scope: 'System-A' and 'downstream systems'. It is unclear whose downstream systems are being referred to.
possible_interpretations: System-A adds System-B to their own downstream systems.
System-A adds System-B to the downstream systems of another entity (not specified).

ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: add System-B to their downstream systems
ambiguity_resolubility.supported_interpretation: System-A adds System-B to their own downstream systems.
evidence_from_requirement: The requirement text uses the pronoun 'their' in a way that implies possession by System-A, not another entity.
evidence_from_context: Glossary: 'downstream systems' definition — External systems that receive events from System-A. This suggests that the downstream systems referred to are those of System-A.
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement text and controlled context provide sufficient information to resolve the ambiguity in favor of the first interpretation.

structured_requirements.final_statement: System-A must add System-B to their own downstream systems and allow System-C to subscribe to the Reporting flow.
structuring_notes: AMB-01 resolved: pronoun 'their' replaced with possessive adjective 'own' per supported interpretation.
